Arbutin Arbutoside; Arbutyna; Beta-arbutin; Ursin. 4-Hydroxyphenyl-βD- glucopyranoside. Арбутин C12H16O7 = 272.3. CAS — 497-76-7 (beta-arbutin); 84380-01-8 (alpha-ar- butin). Profile Arbutin is a glycosylated derivative of hydroquinone (p.1598) extracted from bearberry (p.2263) and similar plants. It is used topically in concentrations of 1 to 5% as a depigmenting agent for the skin in hyperpigmentation disorders. The higher concen- trations may lead to a paradoxical hyperpigmentation. Alpha-arbutin has been used similarly.
